about: Blackheath Heating & Electrical is a team of Gas Safe registered heating engineers and NICEIC approved electricians serving Greenwich, Blackheath and Lewisham. We give plain-English fixed quotes before starting work, protect your floors, and back every installation with a 12-month workmanship guarantee.
